name: aus-skills-assessment-consultant
description: DIY consultant for the Australian skills assessment step that sits underneath skilled and employer-sponsored visas (189, 190, 491, 482/Skills in Demand) — helps pick the correct assessing authority and occupation code, prepares the assessment-specific evidence package (which differs from the visa evidence package), and plans next steps after a negative outcome. Use whenever the user mentions skills assessment, ACS, Engineers Australia, CDR, career episode, RPL, VETASSESS, CPA Australia/CA ANZ/IP
